feature: My Architect (#1746, Feature #1569) -- the real customer-facing retainer page in artifacts/portal (/my-architect), wired to the one real, GET-only endpoint GET /api/portal/retainer -- see Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/docs/my-architect-contract-pack.md. No fixture module: every row on screen (settings, bucket, work log, status reports, adjustmentNotes) comes from this one endpoint. Money (hourlyRateCents) is a real, live field on the response and is never rendered, per contract pack §6.1. #4026 added adjustmentNotes: the real, persisted reason behind any hours change the MSP Console made to an already-closed period (retainer_adjustment_notes) -- rendered as a 'Revisions to closed periods' card, only when non-empty.
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: the honest-empty / unconfigured contract (configured:false, settings:null, bucket computed against the platform default allotment, entries:[], statusReports:[]) -- contract pack §5 -- and that the page renders that state without fabricating data.

REAL LOCAL DB STATE AT THIS BUILD: retainer_settings, retainer_work_log and status_reports (report_status='sent') are all 0 rows on every tenant (confirmed via direct query against DATABASE_URL). A1 below asserts the real, honest unconfigured-shape response this produces on the testbed account -- not a placeholder standing in for real data. Configuring a real retainer (settings + logged hours) is an MSP-side action on admin-retainer.ts, out of scope for this customer-facing manifest -- once a retainer is configured and hours are logged for the testbed tenant, this manifest should be extended with a configured:true / non-empty-entries assertion.

NO UI LOGIN FLOW EXISTS YET FOR artifacts/portal -- same known, already-documented cross-cutting gap test-manifests/portal/security-plan.json's own notes describe. UI1/UI2 below only assert what is honestly reachable today: the route mounts and RequireAuth's honest 'Sign in required' panel renders for an unauthenticated visitor.
ENV VARS (BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables): DEPLOY_URL, TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_EMAIL / TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD.

apiTests.name: SETUP -- log in as the designated testbed portal account; extract the bearer.
A1 -- an account with no retainer_settings row reads configured:false, settings:null, real zero entries/statusReports (contract pack §5) -- not a 500, not fabricated data.
A2 -- settings is null (not a zeroed object) when unconfigured.
A3 -- the bucket still computes against the platform default allotment (8h / 480min) with zero used -- a real default, not an absent field.
A4 -- entries is a real empty array, not omitted, on an account with zero work-log rows.
A5 -- statusReports is independent of configured -- a real empty array here, not conflated with the retainer's own configured state.
A6 (#4026) -- adjustmentNotes is a real array on the response, not omitted -- retainer_adjustment_notes has 0 rows for this account, so it reads empty, not the field being absent.

uiSteps.name: UI1 -- an unauthenticated visitor to /my-architect sees the app's own honest sign-in-required panel (no login page exists yet -- see notes), not a crash or a silently-empty page.
